messages:
Maya (Finance): Echolabs INV-4821 autopay charge failed - gateway says 'Do Not Honor'. Attempted at 03:11 PT, amount €12,340.52. Customer on file: Echolabs B.V. EU entity. Do we auto-retry or offer wire fallback?
Amir (Billing Ops): How many retry attempts left on that invoice? Also what's the BIN/country?
stanley-payments-bot: ChargeAttempt: id=ch_9X23, code=5, gateway_msg=DO_NOT_HONOR, time=2025-06-02T03:11:47Z, attempts=1. Retry policy = 3 total attempts by default.
Nora (Acct Mgmt): Just spoke with their AP team - they said card issuer won't release funds today, they prefer to wire. Offered to send wire instructions. They asked if we can mark invoice as 'pending wire' and cancel further card retries.
Maya (Finance): If they opt for wire we'll stop card retries. Need confirmation from Risk for >€10k transfers (AML/docs). Also we should not proactively send bank details until customer explicitly requests.
Lena (Risk): Flag - amount > €10k, please request: company registration number + payer bank statement or payment authorization. Once received we can allow wire.
Amir (Billing Ops): Ops checklist if switching to wire: 1) disable autopay on INV-4821 2) set invoice status note 'pending wire per customer' 3) cancel remaining scheduled card retries 4) attach Zendesk ticket id to invoice 5) reconcile when funds received. I'll do steps 1-3 after confirmation.
Nora (Acct Mgmt): Customer just replied: 'We will send wire today by 17:00 CET. Please send your wire template and include the invoice reference.' I'm going to ask them to send payer bank confirmation after they initiate the transfer.
Maya (Finance): Wire template (send only after they confirm / Risk cleared):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: Nimbus Bank NL
IBAN: NL00NMBK0123456789
SWIFT/BIC: NMBKNL2X
Amount: EUR 12,340.52
Reference: INV-4821 / Echolabs B.V.
Please attach a copy of the payer bank confirmation to the payment email.
```
Maya (Finance): Also note - route the wire to the NL account above, add invoice ref exactly as shown to speed reconciliation.
Lena (Risk): Once Nora gets payer confirmation, upload docs to the risk folder and ping me. Approve after quick check (company reg + payer match).
Amir (Billing Ops): I'll mark the invoice internal note and disable autopay now, pending Nora's send.
Nora (Acct Mgmt): Sending template now to customer and asking for payer confirmation + company reg number. Will update thread when they respond.
Maya (Finance): Thanks. After funds land please confirm with txn id so we can reconcile same-day. :white_check_mark:
Nora (Acct Mgmt): Customer: 'Confirmed, will send proof once done.' I'll move to pending-wire and attach ticket #5472.
stanley-payments-bot: Reminder scheduled: auto-retry attempt 2 canceled for ch_9X23 per note 'customer opted for wire'.
Amir (Billing Ops): Closing ops loop: I'll follow up tomorrow EOD if no confirmation.
Maya (Finance): Great - keeping this thread as reference for accounting reconciliation and audit.
Nora (Acct Mgmt): Will update Zendesk + ERP once payment confirmed. End.
